# Castor Dental Associates

> Private family dental practice in downtown Naples, Florida, since April 2014, at 785 Central Avenue (Naples, FL 34102). Dr. Joseph A. Castor, DMD, has practiced since 1996 and graduated with honors from Temple University School of Dentistry. Phone 239.300.4635, fax 239.330.7250, email Castordentalassociates@gmail.com. Amanda, on the team, speaks Spanish. In pain or an emergency: call; every attempt will be made to see you that day.

## Orthodontics

- [Stealth Orthodontics™](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#straight): super-elastic wires bonded to the lingual (tongue) side of the teeth, sometimes with custom clear trays, so the wire does not show from the front. In most cases about half the cost of traditional braces; generally within six months, depending on the case; suitable for any age. The site shows one patient's case, completed in five months.
- [Invisalign® and Six Month Smiles®](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#straight): Dr. Castor is certified in both. Invisalign: clear aligners in SmartTrack® material, a new set typically every week. Six Month Smiles: clear Lucid-Lok® brackets and tooth-colored wires for more advanced cases; treatment averages six months.

## Care

- [Keeping teeth healthy](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#care): cleanings with one of four registered dental hygienists; tooth-colored composite fillings; children's dentistry, with a first visit just after the third birthday, fluoride and sealants; root canal treatment and extractions, with referrals to an endodontist or an oral surgeon when a case needs one.
- [Restorations that look natural](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#care): crowns and bridges in high-grade porcelain or porcelain bonded to gold; composite or porcelain veneers; bonding; whitening with custom trays and gel used at home; Dr. Castor is certified in laser dentistry.
- [Replacing teeth](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#care): implants, placed by a referred oral and maxillofacial surgeon and restored by Dr. Castor, usually six to eight months in all; complete or partial dentures.
- [Technology and specialists](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#care): intraoral camera, digital X-rays (radiographs) and digital impressions; referrals to vetted periodontists, endodontists, oral surgeons and orthodontists, who keep the practice updated.

## Team

## Reviews

- [What patients notice](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#reviews): 36 reviews from RateABiz, RateMDs and Google, posted between 2014 and 2017 and published on the practice's site. Patients mention the intraoral camera and clear explanations, no overselling, short waits, and a relaxed coastal office.

## Costs

- [Insurance, payment and financing](https://www.castordentalassociates.com/#costs): up-front cost information before treatment; the practice bills your insurance. Plans: Delta Dental, Guardian, MetLife, Ameritas, Cigna Dental, Aetna. Check, Visa, MasterCard and Discover; payment is due at the time of service; for major restorative work, half up front and the balance when the work is delivered. Financing through CareCredit.
